mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee (id, password, name, department_id, post) VALUES (#{id}, #{password}, #{name}, #{departmentId}, #{post})
mapper.select: SELECT , d.id AS dept_id, d.name AS dept_name, d.address AS dept_address FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON d.id = e.department_id WHERE e.id = #{id}
